purpose.en: Build the backs of your upper arms.

text.zh: 大臂贴住身体不动，把小臂往后伸直
text.en: Keep your upper arms still and straighten your arms back

text.zh: 身体前倾，背保持平直，膝盖微弯。
text.en: Lean forward with a flat back and soft knees.

text.zh: 伸直后停一下，再慢慢弯回来。
text.en: Pause with your arms straight, then bend back slowly.

cautions.zh: 用轻重量，先做 1 组轻松的 6 次
cautions.en: Use light weights and start with one easy set of 6 reps.

cautions.zh: 腰不舒服时上身抬高一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your lower back feels uncomfortable, raise your chest a little, and stop if it still hurts.
